A '''prison''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] was used by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] to hold prisoners. In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] [[Executive officer/Legends|executive officer]] [[Tycho Celchu/Legends|Tycho Celchu]] was held there while his [[Trial of Tycho Celchu|trial]] for the supposed [[Death/Legends|murder]] of fellow Rogue [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was underway.<ref name="kt">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>

The prison had solitary confinement for unruly prisoners, and visitation rooms that separated visitors from the prisoners by a [[Transparisteel/Legends|transparisteel]] wall. Its [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Security guard/Legends|guards]] were armed with [[Spray stick/Legends|Stokhli spray sticks]].<ref name="kt" />
